lines: I first brought down a karate chop onto the medulla oblongata of the woman whose joint I had locked―――the rude one who had tried to take off my clothes.
I casually tossed the body of the woman, who had limply collapsed, at the female prisoner who came at me from the right.
That one, who was surprisingly considerate for a prisoner, caught that heavy load without thinking.
I took advantage of that opportunity to sharply advance into the opposition side,
Lowered my body to dodge the punch that was unleashed, then promptly closed in and drove an elbow strike into the pit of her stomach.
It looked like I had gotten her in a pretty good spot, as she crouched down and began throwing up.
「If you're going to puke, go to the toilet.」
Uh-oh, another one approaching from behind.
I skillfully manoeuvred my body as I raised my right foot and kicked her in the jaw, in something akin to a backwards roundhouse kick.
Her chin jerked back, and she was blown backwards at full force.
She swiftly flew three metres through the air and landed hard onto the floor on her back, but by that time, she had already passed out.

「Y-You bitch!」
「You're strong, for havin' those cowtits, aren'tcha?!」
I didn't think strength had anything to do with having cowtits, but for now, I responded thusly.
I pinned down the hand that had grabbed for me and fixed my opponent's body in place, then sent the heel of my palm into her jaw.
「I'm not underestimating you, though, am I?」
I sidestepped another person, kneed her in the stomach, and brought an elbow down onto her back while I was at it.
I brought down two more in a row.
I said with plenty of composure, looking at the prisoners, who were reduced to about half.
My movements were so sharp that it impressed even me.
It was thanks to having received a lot of combat training over the summer break from my household's oniwaban, Library.
The woman who had looked to be the most capable beforehand grinned.
It looked like she had been spectating as her underlings were getting beaten up.
Seeming to have some kind of experience, she formed fists with both hands, and began to bob back-and-forth rhythmically, like a kickboxer.
「Looks like once I beat you, it'll be over, huh?」
「Try it if you can, cowtit lady!」
The woman suddenly changed the rhythmic hopping motion that she had been showing off, and stepped forward.
It was a low lick to the right, with delayed timing to throw me off.
It was pretty magnificent, but a surprise attack on this level was nothing compared to the protean nature of Library's.
As I'd been trained, I raised my knee and firmly guarded against the kick with my shin.
And then, as I brought my leg down, I stepped forward, and, to avoid being showered with consecutive attacks, made a containment jab to the left―――
The woman tried to guard against it, but the jab was a feint.
I suddenly loosened my fingers and let them drain of strength, then swung my arm like a whip, slipped past the guard she put up, and hit her right around the eyes with the backs of my digits.
It was a technique called meuchi, which was different from a straight poke in the eyes.
The woman reflexively closed her eyes.
Taking advantage of that opening, I stepped in even closer, and dealt her a right-hand body blow, which was thrust up from below along the lines of a shovel hook.
The woman's body rose up into the air a little, and a cracking sensation was conveyed to my fist. There was little doubt that some of her ribs had been broken.
The woman doubled over in a く shape, holding her stomach and groaning.
While desperately withstanding the intense pain, the woman came at me with a counterattacking blow―――
I saw something glint in her hand for a moment.
However, I had realized it a moment too late.
The counterattacking knife slit open my side.
「Hey?! That's against the rules, you know?!」
I tried to say, although there were no such things as rules in a prison beating. I was at fault for letting my guard down.
Of course, the woman didn't listen, and thrust out her knife with gleaming eyes.
She herself probably believed this would be the finishing blow, but it looked like she wasn't as used to knives as she was to kicking, so the start of the attack was fully telegraphed.
Manoeuvring my body lightly, I dodged her knife and drove a counter punch into the tip of her nose.
The woman let out a voice that sounded like a pig's squeal, and collapsed face-first onto the floor while spurting a spectacular amount of blood from her nose.
She groaned at the end, and fell flat on her face.
I looked at the wound in my side.
It would appear that the spell on those seal piercing things didn't work on my demonic regeneration ability.

「Not going with “no piercings” for my “one-time help” was the right call after all.
......No it wasn't.」
Perhaps thanks to my regeneration ability (which had not been rendered inert, despite those piercings), the pain had disappeared for the time being.
「As long as I don't have to worry...... Well, I'll manage...... I guess.」
In the meantime, my wound had disappeared, but the female prisoners who still remained had started making a commotion.
「Is this girl, like, some upper class-type that the piercing seals don't work on?!」
「Look! If you look closely, this woman's got horns growing on her head, doesn't she?!」
A large number of remarks that, if Kirara-senpai were here, would be not unlikely to result in her turning the whole prison into ice statues.
「Those seem like bad ways of putting it.」
All I did was mutter that without thinking, but
Perhaps because they thought they had incurred the wrath of the Bull Demon Queen, the female prisoners were shuddering.
With the woman holding the knife defeated, it appeared that their will to fight had been lost.
“Good grief. That's step one over with,” I thought, when
It seemed there was still another boss.
From the depths of the prison, out of the darkness where I had thought nobody was, a terribly unpleasant presence began to emanate.
